title: Chat: idle-aware delivery gated on agent state, with --now urgency
body:
Follow-up to 1n3dmw (item 2 there, deferred). Chat injects as soon as ready() is true, even while the receiver is mid-turn, so a steer or blocker waits out a whole agent turn and can be stale by the time it is read. Gate injection on the per-Session agent state (working / needs-input / idle) and let a sender bypass the gate with an urgency flag (--now) for steers that must interrupt.

DEPENDS ON the agent-state work, which is docs only so far: spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-agent-state-design.md, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-25-agent-state.md. Nothing is built (no AgentState in src/). This card is an EXPANSION of that plan, not a duplicate: the plan only shows badges and promises zero bytes written into a Session. Gating injection is a new consumer of its AgentStateSlot. Do not start until the slot exists on Session.

Open design points: (1) what delivery does for a member with no state yet (badge hidden, hook not installed, non-Claude/Codex/Grok agent): fall back to today's ready()-only behaviour. (2) Whether a needs-input member (parked at a permission prompt) should receive posts at all: a paste there lands in the approval prompt. (3) --now is a wire change on the control plane (ChatRequest): skip_serializing_if, v1 byte-identical, see foreman-change-control. (4) Held posts keep the age stamp added in 1n3dmw (frame_at), so a held post shows how long it waited. (5) ReadyGate already queues one post per turn (ready.rs next_paste): the idle gate belongs there or in ChatRoom::tick, not in a second queue.

Pointers: docs/chat-delivery.md, src/ready.rs, src/chat.rs (tick_at), src/wm.rs chat_tick, foreman-agent-state-campaign skill.

Update 2026-10-01: the dependency is DONE. tvmsrv landed on main (commits 1fc9147..347b928). The plan file is deleted; read docs/agent-state.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-agent-state-design.md. The API to consume: src/agent_state.rs AgentStateSlot with badge(icon, exited) -> Option<AgentBadge{state: Working|NeedsYou|Idle, finished}}; src/terminal.rs Session::agent_state(); src/wm.rs apply_hook_event feeds it from provider hooks. Known limits to design around (docs/agent-state.md Gotchas): no state before a Session's first hook event; Claude Esc fires no hook so a Session can read Working while idle; state is reset when the agent_state_badges setting flips; the setting gates only the panel paint, the slot is fed regardless, so decide whether delivery gating should also respect the setting or run whenever hooks are installed. Gate: cargo build --target-dir target/agent; cargo test --target-dir target/agent.
